spans.s: शबर m. The same as शवर q.v.
शाव(ब)र (I) a. (f. री) 1. Barbarous; 2. low, vile.
शाव(ब)र (II) m. 1. Sin, wickedness; 2. fault, offence; 3. the Lodhra tree.
शबल a. The same as शवल q.v.
शबला f. A spotted cow.
शबला f. A spotted cow.
सबलि m. Evening twilight.

शब्द् vt. 10U (pp. शब्दित; pres. शब्दयति-ते) 1. To sound, to make any noise; 2. to call, to call out to, to speak, विततमृदुकराग्रः शब्दयंत्या वयोभिः परिपतति दिवोऽंके हेलया बालसूर्यः Sis.xi.47.With प्र-, to explain.

शब्द m. 1. Sound, noise, स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत् Bg.i.13, विश्वासोपगमादभिन्नगतयः Sak.i.; 2. sound (considered as the property of आकाश); See R.xiii.1; 3. the sound of a musical instrument, K.S.i.45; 4. a word, a significant word, क्षत्रस्य शब्दो भुवनेषु रूढः R.ii.53; 5. a declinable word, a substantive (in gram.); 6. verbal authority (considered as a प्रमाण by the Naiyāyikas); 7. title, epithet, नृपेण चक्रे युवराजशब्दभाक् R.iii.35, ii.64, iii.49, v.22.
शाब्द (I) a. (f. ब्दी) 1. Relating to or derived from a word; 2. relating to sound, (op. to आर्थ); 3. sonorous, sounding.
शाब्द (II) m. A grammarian.
शब्द-अतीत a. beyond the reach of language, indescribable.
शब्द-अधिष्ठान n. the ear.
शब्द-अध्याहार m. supplying an ellipsis.
शब्द-अनुशासन n. the science of words, i.e. grammar.
शब्द-अर्थ (I) m. du. a word and its sense.
शब्द-अर्थ (II) m. the meaning of a word.
शब्द-अलंकार m. a figure of speech depending on words or sound; (such an अलम्कार vanishes if the words on which it depends are substituted by others of the same meaning; for instances, See K.Pr.ix.)
शब्द-आख्येय (I) a. fit to be communicated in words, Megh.ii.40.
शब्द-आख्येय (II) n. a verbal massage.
शब्द-आडंबर m. verbosity, bombast.
शब्द-कोश m. a dictionary, a lexicon.
शब्द-गत a. being or residing in word.
शब्द-ग्रह m. 1. the ear; 2. catching sound.
शब्द-चातुर्य n. cleverness of diction.

शब्द-चित्र n. one of the two subdivisions of the last division of poetry; in it, the charm consists in the fanciful use of words giving pleasure to the ear by mere sound; the following is an instance, मित्रात्रिपुत्रनेत्राय त्रयीशात्रवशत्रेव । गोत्रारिगोत्रजैत्राय गोत्रात्रे ते नमो नमः R.G.
शब्द-चोर m. a plagiarist.
शब्द-तन्मात्र n. the subtile element of sound.
शब्द-पति m. a nominal lord, ननु शब्दपतिः क्षितेरहं स्वयि मे भावनिबंधना रतिः R.viii.52.
शब्द-बोध m. knowledge derived from verbal testimony (in phil.).
शाब्द-बोध m. apprehension of the meaning of words.
शब्द-ब्रह्मन् n. 1. the Vedas; 2. the same as स्फोट q.v.
शब्द-भेदिन् m. 1. an epithet of Arjuna; 2. the anus; 3. a kind of arrow.
शब्द-विद्या f. grammar, शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतोरपस्पशा Sis.ii.112.
शब्द-शासन n. grammar, शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतोरपस्पशा Sis.ii.112.
शब्द-शास्त्र n. grammar, शब्दविद्येव नो भाति राजनीतोरपस्पशा Sis.ii.112.
शब्द-विरोध m. opposition of words in a sentence.
शब्द-वृत्ति f. the function of a word (in rhetoric).
शब्द-वेधिन् (I) a. hitting an invisible mark by the clue of mere sound.
शब्द-वेधिन् (II) m. 1. an epithet of Arjuna; 2. a kind of arrow.
शब्द-शक्ति f. the expressive power of a word.
शब्द-शुद्धि f. correct use of words.
शब्द-श्लेष m. a play upon words, a verbal equivoque, a pun; (it differs from अर्थश्लेष in that the figure vanishes if the words on which it depends are substituted by others of the same meaning).
शब्द-संग्रह m. a vocabulary, a lexicon.
शब्द-सौष्ठव a. elegance of diction.
शब्दन (I) a. (f. ना) Sounding.
शब्दन (II) n. 1. Making a noise, uttering a sound; 2. sound, noise; 3. calling, calling out.
शब्दन (I) a. (f. ना) Sounding.
शब्दाय् vt. or vi. (denom. pres. शब्दायते) 1. To make a sound, to make a noise, शब्दायंते मधुरमनिलैः कीचकाः पूर्यमाणाः Megh.i.56, Bt.v.52; 2. to call, to call out.
शब्दित a. (f. ता) 1. Sounded, made to give out a sound; 2. uttered, called, willed out to, (pp. of शब्द् q.v.).
शब्दित a. (f. ता) 1. Sounded, made to give out a sound; 2. uttered, called, willed out to, (pp. of शब्द् q.v.).
शाब्द (I) a. (f. ब्दी) 1. Relating to or derived from a word; 2. relating to sound, (op. to आर्थ); 3. sonorous, sounding.
साब्दी f. A kind of grape.
शाब्द-व्यंजना f. insinuation founded on words (in rhetoric).
शाब्दिक m. A grammarian.
शाव(ब)र-भेदाक्ष n. copper.
शाव(ब)री f. A low Prākṛt dialect.
सबंधु (I) a. Possessed of a friend, befriended.
सबंधु (II) m. A kinsman, a relation.
सब्रह्मचर्य n. Fellow-studentship.
सब्रह्मचारिन् m. 1. A fellow-student, one engaged in the same studies and observing the same austerities; 2. a fellow sufferer, हे व्यसनसब्रह्मचारिन् यदि न गुह्यं ततः श्रोतिमिच्छामि Mud.vi.
